firstPlayerRule: The player to the left of the dealer (the first hand) bids first and makes the opening lead. The dealer bids last.
houseFallback: The page does not say who deals; use the picker.

sources.title: Oh Pshaw: How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Oh Pshaw page. "The Bidding: Beginning with the player to the left of the dealer (the first hand), each player in turn bids exactly the number of tricks that they expect to win." "The Play: The first hand makes the opening lead."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the dealer is chosen.
